title: claimYieldFeeShares clears the whole yieldFeeBalance on a partial claim; remaining fee backing is then liquidated to the liquidation pair
description: Discovery: Q3.2 / cross-contract read of the liquidation-source flow. claimYieldFeeShares(_shares) mints only _shares but decrements yieldFeeBalance by the full cached balance. yieldFeeBalance is part of _totalDebt, so the dropped part of the debt is immediately counted as available yield by availableYieldBalance(), and the external LiquidationPair can then buy it through transferTokensOut (asset withdrawn from the yield vault, or shares minted) in exchange for prize tokens. The fee entitlement is transferred to liquidation-pair takers and the prize pool.
root_cause: Line 617 `yieldFeeBalance -= _yieldFeeBalance;` should be `-= _shares`. The cached full balance is subtracted, so unminted fee shares vanish from totalDebt.

harm.loses_what: all unclaimed fee shares beyond the claimed amount (backing assets become liquidatable yield sold for prize tokens)

exploit_trace: 1. LiquidationPair trades accrue yieldFeeBalance = 1000 via transferTokensOut.
2. yieldFeeRecipient calls claimYieldFeeShares(100); 100 shares minted, yieldFeeBalance set to 0.
3. totalDebt drops by 1000 while supply rose by 100: availableYieldBalance rises by 900.
4. The liquidation pair (any taker) calls transferTokensOut for the extra 900 and pays prize tokens at the pair's auction price; the fee recipient's 900 entitlement is unrecoverable.

postconditions.text: totalDebt understated; fee backing exposed to liquidation

audit_trail.who_benefits: Liquidation pair takers and the prize pool
